intro.text: The mother of Szeth, a Shin woman living on a shepherding homestead outside Clearmount.
The late mother of Szeth, a Shin woman who followed her son to the Stoneward monastery before returning to pastoral life.

items.text: Neturo shared his unorthodox view of Stone Shamanism with Zeenid, and she too began to question the orthodoxy. They married and lived year-round on a homestead an hour's walk from Clearmount, as no one in town would rent to them. They had two children, Szeth and Elid, and Zeenid oversaw painting classes in town and told her children stories by the hearth.

In 1149, when Szeth found a new rock near the family's sacred stone, Zeenid hurried home with a shovel, relieved at how small it was. She and Neturo planned to move it quietly so their homestead wouldn't be declared holy ground, and Szeth agreed. When horns warned of raiders, Zeenid hid the stone under leaves by a nearby tree, and the family fled with the sheep to the mountains.

When Szeth was found beside a dead soldier, killed with the stone, Zeenid defended him to the Farmer and protested at turning an eleven-year-old into a killer. When Neturo said he would follow Szeth to the monastery, she declared that she and Elid would come too. She made Szeth a toy sheep from the wool of his beloved Molli, crying as she gave it to him.

Zeenid took badly to the soldiers' camp, yearning for the open fields, losing weight and avoiding Neturo whenever she could. When Szeth was made to jog laps as punishment, she brought him water and made him rest, and urged him to wash out of training and be sent to the mines rather than become a killer.

When Szeth became an acolyte of the Shamans in 1157, Zeenid blamed Neturo for forcing her into the camp and declared she would repent and return to pastoral life, which she could do, never having killed anyone. She went to live with her sisters, and Neturo believes she was happier without him than she had ever been with him.
Zeenid died of tumours sometime between 1157 and 1175, with Elid holding her hand.

appearance.text: Zeenid has curly light brown hair. Before the family moves to the monastery, she wears a long green skirt as her splash, with a white apron over it, containing an unusual amount of coloured fabric for someone of her station.

personality.text: Zeenid is skilled at managing people, tends to avoid conflict and is troubled by living among soldiers. Neturo persuaded her to take a lax, unorthodox view of Stone Shamanism. Fiercely protective of Szeth when he is young, she comes to feel he should be able to fend for himself as he grows older.
